ns2:section.sectionText: This course takes a hands-on approach to econometric modeling in labor, public, urban and other applied microeconomic fields. We begin with an overview of approaches (e.g., structural or reduced form), issues with replication (e.g. over-rejection), and scientific method (e.g. falsifiability) and etiquette (e.g. how to receive feedback). Students will then choose a published article related to their anticipated research agenda to replicate, present in class, and eventually develop an alteration or extension to.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
